title: The Google Pixel 11 Pro XL bending resistance tested in teardown video
description: Google launched the Pixel 11 Pro XL earlier this month, along with the Pixel 11, Pixel 11 Pro, and Pixel 11 Pro Fold. If you've been wondering how the XL model stands up to scratches, open flames, or attempts to bend it, you're in luck. [#InlinePriceWidget,14800,1#] The video below explores just that, in a traditional "durability test" format, before disassembling the entire handset for your viewing pleasure. So grab some popcorn and/or a beverage of your choice, hit play, and enjoy the ride. The glass scratches at level 6 on the Mohs scale, with deeper grooves appearing at level...

title: vivo V80 Lite 5G debuts with Dimensity 7360 chipset, 7,050 mAh battery
description: vivo has now quietly launched the V80 Lite 5G in Pakistan. This is not to be confused with the V80 Lite 5G that will be landing in India on September 3, since the two look nothing alike. The Pakistani version comes with a 6.83-inch curved POLED display with 1260x2800 resolution, 120Hz refresh rate, and 3,000-nit peak brightness. It's powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 7360-Turbo chipset, paired with 8GB of LPDDR4X RAM and 128/256GB of UFS 3.1 storage. On the rear there's a 50MP main camera and a 2MP depth sensor, while for selfies you get a 32MP snapper. Keeping the lights on is a...

title: After AnTuTu, Qualcomm's upcoming flagship Snapdragon chip appears on Geekbench powering an alleged iQOO 16
description: Qualcomm is hosting its annual Snapdragon Summit next month, from September 22-24 in Hawaii, where it's expected to introduce two new flagship Snapdragon mobile chips. One is rumored to have part number SM8950, while the other is SM8975. The latter was spotted on AnTuTu over a week ago and has now appeared on Geekbench as well. An unnamed device bearing model code vivo V2606A - and believed to be the iQOO 16 - has been listed on the Geekbench database with Android 17, 16GB RAM, and SM8975. The SM8975 was previously called the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Pro, but tipster Digital Chat Station...

title: Samsung launches One UI 9 beta 6 for the Galaxy S26 series
description: About a couple of weeks after Samsung released the fifth beta of One UI 9 for the Galaxy S26 series, today the company is rolling out the sixth beta build. It's an 851MB update and includes the August 5, 2026 security patches. It's currently available in Germany, India, Poland, the UK, and Korea and should be making its way to the US soon. If you are part of the beta program, once you've installed the sixth beta, your phone will be running build ZZHE. It includes fixes for display errors with the Now Brief widget and the home screen, photo-saving issues in Expert RAW 24MP at some focal...

title: Leakster details the upcoming Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Pro and Dimensity 9600 Pro flagship chipsets
description: We already saw Xiaomi’s new chipset post some impressive results, but it’s held back by some older tech – it’s a 3nm chip (TSMC N3P) and uses Arm C1 cores. The upcoming chips from Qualcomm and MediaTek promise to be even better, though neither company has revealed official details yet. So instead, leakster Digital Chat Station offers a preview. The "Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6", which we assume means the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Pro (SM8975), will be fabbed on TSMC’s new 2nm node (N2P). The CPU will crack the 5GHz barrier with its two Prime cores clocked at 5.01GHz. The 8-core CPU...

title: Take a look at the Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra in some fresh high-quality CAD renders
description: Yesterday a rough CAD render of the upcoming Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra leaked, and now we have a set of much more polished and higher-resolution renders of the device to look at. As is obvious from the very first look, Samsung is redesigning the camera island, opting for an Apple-like (or rather, Poco-like for those who remember) big rectangle up top, with the camera sensors housed in its left side. According to the source of these renders, the Galaxy S27 Ultra will measure 163.76 x 78.25 x 7.97 mm, which makes it imperceptibly larger than its predecessor on all three axes....

title: Xiaomi wins EISA Smartphone award, Honor, Oppo, and Samsung get some love as well
description: EISA, the Expert Imaging and Sound Association, has announced its latest 2026-2027 smartphone awards. These are basically voted on by multiple EISA member publications, which have tested the products during the year using their own criteria, and there are at least five EISA member publications that have reviewed each device. Xiaomi 17T Pro The Xiaomi 17T Pro won the EISA Smartphone award, thanks to its camera system, display, flagship chipset, and long-lasting battery. The Honor Magic V6 won the EISA Foldable Smartphone award, thanks to its class-leading battery capacity, IP ratings,...

title: Samsung's updated Smart Switch is easier to use and copies more data
description: Samsung’s latest One UI 9 makes switching phones easier – the updated Smart Switch app now has a simpler set-up process and it can copy more data too. If you are moving from an iPhone to a Galaxy Z8 foldable, you no longer need to install Smart Switch on the iPhone. The app on the Android side will generate a QR code that you scan with the iPhone’s camera app, then you need to confirm a few options and you’re ready to go. Even better, the new app is able to copy more data from your old iPhone – the transfer now includes passwords and passkeys, call history, accessibility settings...

title: Nothing OS 5.0 officially debuts, rollout detailed
description: Nothing OS 5.0, based on Android 17, will be released in open beta tomorrow, on August 26, at 11:00 BST (that's 12:00 CEST, 13:00 EEST, and 15:30 in India). It will initially only be available for the Nothing Phone (3). More devices will join "over the coming months", starting with the Nothing Phone (4a) Pro in early September, the Phone (4a), Phone (3a) and (3a) Pro in late September, the Phone (2a) and (2a) Plus in mid-October, and the Phone (4b) in mid-December. The Phone (3a) Lite and CMF Phone 2 Pro won't have an open beta program. The general public release of Nothing OS 5.0...

title: Apple introduces new Mac mini and Mac Studio with M6 and M5 chips
description: Apple has updated its desktop Mac lineup with new range of processors for 2026. The Mac mini and the Mac Studio feature the latest generation of Apple's M-series chips, making them the most powerful computers in the company's lineup. The updated Mac mini now comes with the latest generation M6 chip. Based on the 2nm process, the M6 has a new 12-core CPU design along with a new 12-core GPU and dual 16-core NPU. Apple claims the new CPU has the fastest single-core performance in the world. The new GPU with built-in neural accelerators is 2x faster for graphics and 4x faster for AI...

title: Apple M6 and M5 Ultra chips announced
description: Apple announced its latest M-series chips today with the Apple M6 and M5 Ultra. Both are aimed at professional users who want the best macOS performance in more demanding tasks like AI modeling, 3D rendering and complex video editing. Apple M6 The M6 is built on a 2nm process, which allowed Cupertino to fit more transistors on a smaller die while also improving power efficiency. It brings a 12-core CPU (2 more than the M5) featuring 2x super cores, 4x performance units and 6x efficiency cores. Apple revealed that the CPU offers the world’s fastest single-threaded performance. Apple M6...

title: Redmi 17C 5G goes official with Dimensity 6300 SoC and 6,000mAh battery
description: Following a premature retailer listing in Europe earlier this month, the Redmi 17C 5G is now officially unveiled. As the name implies, this is the 5G counterpart to the Redmi 17C 4G and, as such, features a Dimensity 6300 chipset. It is paired with 4GB of LPDDR4X RAM and 64/128GB of UFS 2.2 storage. It also supports expandable storage via the microSD card slot and features a headphone jack. Redmi 17C 5G brings MediaTek's Dimensity 6300 Redmi 17C 5G is built around a 6.9-inch IPS LCD with HD+ resolution, a 120Hz refresh rate and 810 nits peak brightness. There’s an 8MP...

title: Boltt Ace 5G and Evo 4G debut with 6,000mAh batteries and affordable prices
description: India-based smartwatch brand Fire-Boltt has officially entered the smartphone market with the launch of the Boltt Ace 5G and Boltt Evo 4G budget phones in India. The two phones share several specs, run stock Android 16, and are available in multiple colour options. The Boltt Ace 5G features a 6.79-inch LCD display with a 120Hz refresh rate and up to 600 nits of peak brightness. Under the hood, it is powered by a Unisoc T8200 chipset, paired with up to 6GB of RAM and 128GB of internal storage. For photography, the phone features a 64MP primary rear camera and an 8MP selfie...

title: Huawei Mate XT 2 will be unveiled next month
description: Huawei has confirmed that its next tri-fold smartphone, the Mate XT2, will launch next month. According to a recent rumour, the upcoming device could feature a different folding mechanism compared to the original Mate XT. The Huawei Mate XT2 will be unveiled in China on September 7, the company confirmed in a Weibo post. Huawei will also showcase its recently announced HarmonyOS 7 at the event. While Huawei has yet to reveal any other details, the Mate XT2 is rumoured to feature an inward-folding design. The foldable could offer both a cover display and a large internal flexible...

title: Oppo A7 Pro emerges in listing
description: Earlier this month, Oppo announced its A7 Pro Max in China, and we now have our first look at its non-Max sibling, which emerged in a certification listing in Brazil. The A7 Pro appeared with the CPH2931 model number and features an interesting back design with a horizontal camera visor housing two lenses and an LED flash. Oppo A7 Pro (via Technoblog) The same device previously received certification in Thailand and Malaysia. The new certification listing comes from Brazil’s National Telecommunications Agency (Anatel) and reveals the A7 Pro will feature an 8,000 mAh battery instead of...

title: Poco officially confirms the chipsets for the Poco F9 Pro and F9 Ultra
description: We saw the Poco F9 Ultra run Geekbench 7 with the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 – that is last year’s flagship chipset and it was featured on the F8 Ultra. But we don’t have to rely on leaks anymore, Poco has officially confirmed that the new Ultra will use the same Elite Gen 5 chip. The Poco F9 series will use the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 and 8 Elite Gen 5 V-series chips Meanwhile, the Poco F9 Pro will use the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 V-series. Okay, Qualcomm’s naming scheme is a mess, but the V-series chip has the same CPU as the regular Elite Gen 5 chip. What’s different is the GPU,...

title: vivo T5 5G's key specs, design, and launch date revealed
description: vivo launched the T5 4G in May, and last week it teased the T5 5G. Today, vivo's Indian branch announced that it will unveil the T5 5G on September 2 at 12 PM local time in India. Additionally, vivo revealed the T5 5G's key specs, including the Dimensity 7500 Turbo SoC, a 1.5K 144Hz 3D curved AMOLED display, and a 7,050 mAh battery. The image of the T5 5G shared by vivo on its Indian website shows a design almost identical to the Indian iQOO Z11 that went on sale today, suggesting the vivo T5 5G will be a rebranded iQOO Z11. vivo T5 5G's color options • Indian iQOO...

title: iQOO Z11 goes on sale in India
description: The iQOO Z11, introduced in India last week, is now on sale via iQOO's official website, Amazon.in, vivo exclusive stores, Reliance Digital, and other select retail stores. The iQOO Z11 comes in Aurora Green and Celestial Blue colors in India, with four memory options - 6GB/128GB, 8GB/128GB, 8GB/256GB, and 12GB/256GB, priced at INR34,999, INR39,999, INR44,999, and INR49,999, respectively. However, as part of the launch offer, iQOO is offering an instant discount of up to INR3,000 plus an INR1,000 coupon on all models. The iQOO Z11 launched in India has a design and specs different...

title: vivo X500 Pro Max spotted on Geekbench ahead of launch
description: vivo has confirmed that its X500 series will launch in China next month. Ahead of the launch, a vivo smartphone, believed to be the X500 Pro Max, has been spotted on Geekbench. A vivo phone with the model number V2610 has been listed on the Geekbench website. The phone is equipped with a Mediatek MT6995 chipset with 8 cores and a base frequency of 3.10 GHz. The chipset features two cores clocked at 4.55GHz, three cores at 4.35GHz, and another three at 3.10GHz. It is paired with 12GB of RAM, while the device is listed as running Android 17. title: Indian Realme C100i's box outed along with its specs and launch date
description: The Realme C100i launched in some markets back in May, and now it's finally headed to India, where it will be launched on August 27. The Indian model has a different design for its camera bump as you can see from the image below, which shows its retail box. The C100i has a 6.75-inch HD+ LCD screen with a 120Hz refresh rate and 900-nit peak brightness, the Unisoc T7250 chipset at the helm, an 8MP rear camera, a 5MP front camera, and a 6,500 mAh battery with support for 15W charging.
